workflows.name: PM
workflows.description: Business framing and guarded Draft publication without Tech workspace access.

phases.name: Business intake
phases.description: Freeze the assigned root Draft and identify the business outcome.

instructions.description: Read the assigned Task, every Business comment and every available attachment before asking or changing anything; use only backend-provided task, mode and scope. For any missing material fact, publish one concrete question through the durable awaiting-input handshake; retain this unfinished phase, mode/scope/cycle/attempt. Resume requires terminal acknowledgement, fresh immutable run/claim and CAS cursor rebind.
Record actors, problem, desired outcome, constraints and already answered questions; do not design architecture or create technical subtasks.

checks: Task, comments and attachments were read from the assigned Business context.
The draft describes a business problem and measurable outcome without architecture.
evidence: Frozen Business intake summary with source references.
List of unresolved business questions, if any.

phases.name: Draft refinement
phases.description: Refine the complete Business Draft through one meaningful question at a time.

instructions.description: Re-read the assigned Task, all new comments and attachments; compare them with the frozen intake and identify the single highest-impact missing business fact.
Update only allowed Draft fields with CAS. If information is insufficient, ask one concrete question in the same Business Thread and do not publish or complete the assignment.

checks: Title contains three or four meaningful words and no more than 80 characters.
Draft fields, links and relations stay inside the assigned Business project.
evidence: Readback of the current Draft revision.
Answered-question ledger or one pending concrete question.

phases.name: Draft publication
phases.description: Publish a sufficient Draft to Backlog exactly once.

instructions.description: Re-read the assigned Task, all comments and attachments, then verify the final title, description, scope, acceptance, backend-provided priority, dates, ownership, links and revision before terminal publication.

Prepare one precise final Business Markdown comment summarizing outcome, scope, acceptance, remaining assumptions and evidence. Submit the final report through project-workflow --json step --task <session> --report <report>; only after its response returns complete=true, post the prepared comment, read it back, then call only publishDraft. If the Draft is insufficient, publish one concrete question through the durable awaiting-input handshake, retain the current phase and do not call a terminal action.

checks: Draft is internally consistent and publication uses the expected revision.
No routing, mode, stage, workspace or priority choice is performed by this workflow.
evidence: Readback of the final Business comment.
publishDraft receipt or a single pending question.

workflows.name: Analyst
workflows.description: Business analysis and testable requirements without architecture selection.

phases.name: Requirements intake
phases.description: Freeze all assigned Business inputs and establish the analysis boundary.

instructions.description: Read the assigned Task, every Business comment and every attachment; verify backend-assigned role, analysis mode, revision and root scope before analysis. For any missing material fact, publish one concrete question through the durable awaiting-input handshake; retain this unfinished phase, mode/scope/cycle/attempt. Resume requires terminal acknowledgement, fresh immutable run/claim and CAS cursor rebind.
Build a source-indexed glossary, actor map, problem statement, constraints and assumption ledger without selecting architecture.

checks: Every assertion is tied to an assigned source or marked as an assumption.
No architecture, next stage, workspace or priority is chosen.

phases.name: Testable requirements
phases.description: Produce complete functional, non-functional and failure requirements.

instructions.description: Re-read the assigned Task, all comments and attachments, then derive in-scope, out-of-scope, functional and non-functional requirements from the frozen sources.

Define measurable acceptance plus positive, negative, permission, tenant, idempotency, concurrency, restart and partial-failure scenarios. If a P0 fact is missing, ask one concrete question and do not complete.

checks: Requirements are independently testable and non-duplicated.
P0 gaps block completion and are expressed as one concrete question.

phases.name: Analysis handoff
phases.description: Publish a traceable analysis result for architecture.

instructions.description: Re-read the assigned Task, all comments and attachments and verify that the final analysis remains current against the latest Business revision.

Prepare one precise final Business Markdown comment with outcome, problem, scope, requirements, acceptance, risks and source evidence. Submit the final report through project-workflow --json step --task <session> --report <report>; only after its response returns complete=true, post the prepared comment, read it back, persist immutable evidence, then call only completeAssignedStage with outcome passed. If evidence is insufficient, ask one concrete question and do not complete.

checks: Final report contains no architecture decision or technical implementation.
Business comment and immutable evidence were read back before completion.
evidence: Business comment reference and passed receipt.

workflows.name: Architect
workflows.description: Architecture, dependency DAG and complete child-task decomposition.

phases.name: Architecture intake
phases.description: Freeze approved requirements and establish ownership boundaries.

instructions.description: Read the assigned Task, every Business comment and every attachment; verify the backend-provided decomposition mode, root revision and predecessor analysis evidence. For any missing material fact, publish one concrete question through the durable awaiting-input handshake; retain this unfinished phase, mode/scope/cycle/attempt. Resume requires terminal acknowledgement, fresh immutable run/claim and CAS cursor rebind.
Audit existing capabilities, bounded contexts, systems of record and immutable invariants before proposing any new component.

checks: Analysis evidence is complete enough for architecture.
Capability ownership and reuse were checked before new design.

phases.name: Architecture and DAG
phases.description: Design dataflow, contracts, states and failure behavior.

instructions.description: Re-read the assigned Task, all comments and attachments, then define data ownership, boundaries, state machine, APIs/events, permissions, audit and recovery behavior.
Build an acyclic dependency DAG with explicit interfaces, acceptance and integration points; do not choose runtime queue order, workspace slot or next stage.

checks: DAG has no cycle and each dependency direction is explicit.
Design covers versioning, idempotency, concurrency, tenant and partial failure.

phases.name: Subtasks and handoff
phases.description: Create and verify the complete active decomposition revision.

instructions.description: Re-read the assigned Task, all comments and attachments, then create or update scoped child Tasks with acceptance, dependencies and parent links through guarded Business commands.

Read back every child and link, then prepare one precise final Business Markdown comment with outcome, architecture, decomposition revision, DAG, integration criteria and evidence. Submit the final report through project-workflow --json step --task <session> --report <report>; only after its response returns complete=true, post the prepared comment, read it back, persist immutable evidence, then call only completeAssignedStage with outcome passed. If decomposition is incomplete, ask one concrete question and do not complete.

checks: Every required delivery item is represented by a linked child Task.
Readback proves the frozen decomposition revision and all dependency links.
evidence: Business comment, child/link readback and passed receipt.

workflows.name: Developer
workflows.description: Initial, rework and aggregate integration implementation on backend-assigned workspaces.

phases.name: Delivery preflight
phases.description: Freeze child scope and validate the assigned workspace.

instructions.description: Read the assigned Task, every Business comment and every attachment; verify child scope, exact input refs, branch, workspace lease and initial mode without changing parent lifecycle. For any missing material fact, publish one concrete question through the durable awaiting-input handshake; retain this unfinished phase, mode/scope/cycle/attempt. Resume requires terminal acknowledgement, fresh immutable run/claim and CAS cursor rebind. For aggregate scope verify accepted cumulative baseline, prerequisite receipts and composition manifest; do not apply child deltas twice.

Inspect only the assigned repositories and define the smallest testable change against the child acceptance. Before awaiting input obtain trusted scoped Git checkpoint and remote readback; checkpoint is not passed or candidate evidence.

checks: Workspace, branch and pinned inputs match the immutable assignment.
Planned diff is limited to child acceptance.

phases.name: Test-driven implementation
phases.description: Implement the initial child delivery through focused tests.

instructions.description: Re-read the assigned Task, all comments and attachments, then create a red public-boundary test for the required behavior.
Implement the minimal change, run focused tests and use systematic debugging only after a reproducible failure.

checks: The regression test was red before the implementation and green after it.
No unrelated files, secrets, caches or generated trash are included.

phases.name: Commit and handoff
phases.description: Publish exact delivery evidence and complete the assigned stage.

instructions.description: Re-read the assigned Task, all comments and attachments, verify focused checks, publish through the trusted owner adapter all allowed changes, then read back the exact remote SHA and clean workspace. Require one Tech-built immutable candidate SHA/digest and execution receipt before Reviewer; never publish through raw Git credentials or GitLab pipeline/build/artifacts.

Prepare one precise final Business Markdown comment with outcome, changed behavior, tests, commit/MR, exact SHA, residual risks and evidence. Submit the final report through project-workflow --json step --task <session> --report <report>; only after its response returns complete=true, post the prepared comment, persist immutable evidence, then call only completeAssignedStage with outcome passed. If blocked, ask one concrete question and do not complete.

checks: Remote SHA matches the pushed commit and workspace is clean.
No empty commit is created when no source change was required.

phases.name: Finding intake
phases.description: Freeze the new rework cycle and reproduce its findings.

instructions.description: Read the assigned Task, every Business comment and every attachment, including the frozen ReworkRequest; verify cycle, findings, evidence and backend-assigned rework mode. For any missing material fact, publish one concrete question through the durable awaiting-input handshake; retain this unfinished phase, mode/scope/cycle/attempt. Resume requires terminal acknowledgement, fresh immutable run/claim and CAS cursor rebind. For aggregate scope verify accepted cumulative baseline, prerequisite receipts and composition manifest; do not apply child deltas twice.

Reproduce each substantive finding against the exact rejected candidate before changing code; reconcile non-reproducible evidence instead of guessing. Before awaiting input obtain trusted scoped Git checkpoint and remote readback; checkpoint is not passed or candidate evidence.

checks: Cycle and ReworkRequest match the assignment.
Every accepted finding has a reproducer.

phases.name: Focused correction
phases.description: Correct only reproduced findings and protect against regression.

instructions.description: Re-read the assigned Task, all comments and attachments, then add or refine regression tests for reproduced findings.
Apply the smallest correction, run focused tests and verify that unrelated accepted behavior remains unchanged.

checks: Every code change maps to a finding or required regression guard.
All reproduced findings are closed by tests.

phases.name: Rework handoff
phases.description: Push the corrected head and return it to review.

instructions.description: Re-read the assigned Task, all comments and attachments, publish through the trusted owner adapter all allowed corrections, read back the exact remote SHA and verify a clean workspace. Require one Tech-built immutable candidate SHA/digest and execution receipt before Reviewer; never publish through raw Git credentials or GitLab pipeline/build/artifacts.

Prepare one precise final Business Markdown comment mapping the outcome and findings to fixes, tests, exact SHA and evidence. Submit the final report through project-workflow --json step --task <session> --report <report>; only after its response returns complete=true, post the prepared comment, persist immutable evidence, then call only completeAssignedStage with outcome passed. If a finding remains unresolved, ask one concrete question and do not complete.

checks: Corrected remote head is immutable and all findings are accounted for.
Rework returns to Review; the model does not select that route.
evidence: Corrected exact SHA and test evidence.

workflows.name: Reviewer
workflows.description: Independent exact-head review for delivery and aggregate candidates.

phases.name: Exact candidate intake
phases.description: Freeze the child candidate and review scope.

instructions.description: Read the assigned Task, every Business comment and every attachment; verify exact head/base/build, child acceptance, delivery mode and read-only workspace. For any missing material fact, publish one concrete question through the durable awaiting-input handshake; retain this unfinished phase, mode/scope/cycle/attempt. Resume requires terminal acknowledgement, fresh immutable run/claim and CAS cursor rebind. Consume the already Tech-built immutable candidate SHA/digest and receipt; GitLab pipeline/build/artifacts do not prove this gate, and rebuilding is forbidden.
Reconcile candidate provenance before review; an ambiguous or moving head blocks review instead of being guessed.

checks: Head, base, build and assignment refs are immutable and consistent.
Review is independent and read-only.

phases.name: Delivery review
phases.description: Review correctness, contracts, security and test sufficiency.

instructions.description: Re-read the assigned Task, all comments and attachments, then trace the exact diff to requirements, architecture and child acceptance.
Classify only reproducible, actionable findings with severity, location, expected/actual behavior and evidence; do not modify source.

checks: Correctness, compatibility, tenant, permission, audit and failure paths were reviewed.
Every blocking finding is substantive and reproducible.
evidence: Finding list with source locations and reproduction evidence.

phases.name: Review decision
phases.description: Publish passed or needs_rework without choosing routing.

instructions.description: Re-read the assigned Task, all comments and attachments and verify the decision against the same exact candidate head.

Prepare one precise final Business Markdown comment with outcome, exact head, review coverage, decision and evidence. Submit the final report through project-workflow --json step --task <session> --report <report>; only after its response returns complete=true, post the prepared comment, persist immutable evidence, then call only completeAssignedStage with outcome passed, or needs_rework with substantive findings. If data is insufficient, ask one concrete question and do not complete.

checks: needs_rework contains at least one substantive frozen finding.
The model does not select Developer mode, cycle or next stage.

phases.name: Aggregate provenance
phases.description: Freeze root candidate and child evidence set.

instructions.description: Read the assigned root Task, every Business comment and every attachment; verify active decomposition, all child DevOps evidence, aggregate head/base/build and integration mode. For any missing material fact, publish one concrete question through the durable awaiting-input handshake; retain this unfinished phase, mode/scope/cycle/attempt. Resume requires terminal acknowledgement, fresh immutable run/claim and CAS cursor rebind. Consume the already Tech-built immutable candidate SHA/digest and receipt; GitLab pipeline/build/artifacts do not prove this gate, and rebuilding is forbidden.
Reject incomplete barriers or ambiguous child revisions before inspecting the aggregate diff.

checks: Aggregate candidate contains every blocking child at pinned revisions.
Review input is immutable and complete.

phases.name: Cross-child review
phases.description: Review integrated behavior and seam correctness.

instructions.description: Re-read the root Task, all comments and attachments, then review dataflow, contracts, migrations, permissions, ordering and recovery across child boundaries.
Record only aggregate or seam findings with exact location, reproduction and impact; do not relitigate accepted child-local work without new evidence.

checks: Integration acceptance and cross-child failure paths were reviewed.
Findings distinguish aggregate defects from child evidence.

phases.name: Aggregate review decision
phases.description: Publish the independent root decision.

instructions.description: Re-read the root Task, all comments and attachments and verify the final decision against the unchanged aggregate head.

Prepare one precise final Business Markdown comment with outcome, child set, aggregate coverage, decision and evidence. Submit the final report through project-workflow --json step --task <session> --report <report>; only after its response returns complete=true, post the prepared comment, persist immutable evidence, then call only completeAssignedStage with outcome passed, or needs_rework with substantive findings. If insufficient, ask one concrete question and do not complete.

checks: Decision covers the whole root candidate, not one child.
No route, mode or workspace is selected by the model.

workflows.name: Tester
workflows.description: Independent delivery and aggregate acceptance with evidence-backed rework findings.

phases.name: Acceptance intake
phases.description: Freeze deployed child candidate and test matrix.

instructions.description: Read the assigned Task, every Business comment and every attachment; verify exact deployed SHA, environment, identities, child acceptance and delivery mode. For any missing material fact, publish one concrete question through the durable awaiting-input handshake; retain this unfinished phase, mode/scope/cycle/attempt. Resume requires terminal acknowledgement, fresh immutable run/claim and CAS cursor rebind. Consume the already Tech-built immutable candidate SHA/digest and receipt; GitLab pipeline/build/artifacts do not prove this gate, and rebuilding is forbidden.

Reconcile deployment provenance and map acceptance to positive, negative, permission, tenant, versioning and recovery scenarios. Use only the temporary candidate sandbox; accepted target remains unchanged until promotion.

checks: Deployed revision matches the reviewed candidate.
Test matrix covers all child acceptance and critical failures.

phases.name: Delivery execution
phases.description: Execute acceptance without repairing the product.

instructions.description: Re-read the assigned Task, all comments and attachments. Prepare rwork sandbox <session> <operation-key>; only an ACTIVE owner-bound exact candidate receipt permits testing and never means functional PASS. Use tester-browser <session> <action-json> only through the isolated current-run CDP proxy pinned by owner browser-context; arbitrary browser tools, Python, JavaScript/CDP and shared Dev targets are forbidden. Execute happy, validation, ACL, tenant, stale, idempotency, concurrency, restart and partial-failure paths. Preserve actual scenario/evidence refs for the owner TestReport; verified sandbox cleanup is mandatory before terminal or question ACK.
For each failure, capture reproducible expected/actual behavior and evidence; use systematic debugging only to localize, never to change source or runtime.

checks: Observed results are tied to exact environment and identity.
No source, configuration or deployment mutation was performed.

phases.name: Acceptance decision
phases.description: Publish passed or needs_rework for the child candidate.

instructions.description: Re-read the assigned Task, all comments and attachments and reconcile defects against the unchanged deployed candidate.

Prepare one precise final Business Markdown comment with outcome, environment, coverage, observed results, decision and evidence. Submit the final report through project-workflow --json step --task <session> --report <report>; only after its response returns complete=true, post the prepared comment, persist immutable evidence, then call only completeAssignedStage with outcome passed, or needs_rework with substantive findings. If data is insufficient, ask one concrete question and do not complete.

checks: needs_rework findings include reproduction, expected/actual and evidence refs.
The model does not choose rework cycle, mode or next stage.

phases.name: Aggregate acceptance intake
phases.description: Freeze integrated deployment and root acceptance.

instructions.description: Read the assigned root Task, every Business comment and every attachment; verify deployed aggregate SHA, child set, active decomposition and integration mode. For any missing material fact, publish one concrete question through the durable awaiting-input handshake; retain this unfinished phase, mode/scope/cycle/attempt. Resume requires terminal acknowledgement, fresh immutable run/claim and CAS cursor rebind. Consume the already Tech-built immutable candidate SHA/digest and receipt; GitLab pipeline/build/artifacts do not prove this gate, and rebuilding is forbidden.

Build a root test matrix covering business journey, cross-child contracts, permissions, data consistency and recovery. Use only the temporary candidate sandbox; accepted target remains unchanged until promotion.

checks: Aggregate deployment contains all pinned children.
Root matrix tests composition rather than repeating isolated child checks.

phases.name: End-to-end execution
phases.description: Execute complete root journeys and failure recovery.

instructions.description: Re-read the root Task, all comments and attachments. Prepare rwork sandbox <session> <operation-key>; only an ACTIVE owner-bound exact aggregate candidate receipt permits testing and never means functional PASS. Use tester-browser <session> <action-json> only through the isolated current-run CDP proxy pinned by owner browser-context; arbitrary browser tools, Python, JavaScript/CDP and shared Dev targets are forbidden. Execute end-to-end happy, negative, tenant, concurrency, restart and partial-failure scenarios across child seams. Preserve actual scenario/evidence refs for the owner TestReport; verified sandbox cleanup is mandatory before terminal or question ACK.
Capture reproducible aggregate findings without product changes; localize only with read-only systematic debugging.

checks: All critical root journeys and seams were exercised.
Evidence distinguishes environment failure from product defect.

phases.name: Root acceptance decision
phases.description: Publish aggregate passed or needs_rework.

instructions.description: Re-read the root Task, all comments and attachments and verify the decision against the same aggregate deployment.

Prepare one precise final Business Markdown comment with outcome, aggregate environment, journeys, seam results, decision and evidence. Submit the final report through project-workflow --json step --task <session> --report <report>; only after its response returns complete=true, post the prepared comment, persist immutable evidence, then call only completeAssignedStage with outcome passed, or needs_rework with substantive findings. If insufficient, ask one concrete question and do not complete.

checks: Decision covers root composition and all blocking children.
No route, rework mode or cycle is selected by the model.

workflows.name: DevOps
workflows.description: Exact-SHA delivery and aggregate deployment with rollback evidence.

phases.name: Release preflight
phases.description: Freeze reviewed/tested child candidate and target inventory.

instructions.description: Read the assigned Task, every Business comment and every attachment; verify exact source/artifact SHA, approvals, target, lease, delivery mode and rollback boundary. For any missing material fact, publish one concrete question through the durable awaiting-input handshake; retain this unfinished phase, mode/scope/cycle/attempt. Resume requires terminal acknowledgement, fresh immutable run/claim and CAS cursor rebind. Consume the already Tech-built immutable candidate SHA/digest and receipt; GitLab pipeline/build/artifacts do not prove this gate, and rebuilding is forbidden.
Capture target inventory, current release and backup/rollback plan before mutation; ambiguous state must be reconciled, not retried blindly.

checks: Candidate is frozen and all required human gates are present.
Backup and rollback target are exact and restorable.

phases.name: Exact deployment
phases.description: Deploy only the assigned immutable child candidate.

instructions.description: Re-read the assigned Task, all comments and attachments, then deploy the pinned artifact only to the assigned target using the approved procedure. Require human Go/No-Go and expected previous deployment CAS; use the same candidate, then publish cumulative acceptance receipt only after exact runtime readback.
Read back source/image/model versions and run scoped health/smoke checks; on failure follow the approved rollback and reconcile before retry.

checks: Runtime readback equals the assigned exact candidate.
Health, smoke and rollback readiness are recorded.

phases.name: Deployment handoff
phases.description: Publish immutable deployment result.

instructions.description: Re-read the assigned Task, all comments and attachments and verify final runtime state, health and evidence against the same candidate.

Prepare one precise final Business Markdown comment with outcome, candidate, target, readback, health, rollback refs and evidence. Submit the final report through project-workflow --json step --task <session> --report <report>; only after its response returns complete=true, post the prepared comment, persist immutable evidence, then call only completeAssignedStage with outcome passed. If state is ambiguous or unhealthy, ask one concrete question or reconcile and do not complete.

checks: Published result is based on runtime readback, not command exit alone.
The model does not choose next stage or mark parent complete.

phases.name: Aggregate release preflight
phases.description: Freeze root candidate, child manifests and target state.

instructions.description: Read the assigned root Task, every Business comment and every attachment; verify aggregate exact SHA, child inputs, approvals, target and integration mode. For any missing material fact, publish one concrete question through the durable awaiting-input handshake; retain this unfinished phase, mode/scope/cycle/attempt. Resume requires terminal acknowledgement, fresh immutable run/claim and CAS cursor rebind. Consume the already Tech-built immutable candidate SHA/digest and receipt; GitLab pipeline/build/artifacts do not prove this gate, and rebuilding is forbidden.
Capture complete target inventory plus coordinated backup and rollback plan for all affected components before mutation.

checks: Aggregate manifest matches reviewed and tested root candidate.
Rollback preserves component compatibility and data boundaries.

phases.name: Aggregate deployment
phases.description: Deploy and verify the complete integrated release.

instructions.description: Re-read the root Task, all comments and attachments, then deploy only pinned aggregate artifacts in the approved dependency order. Require human Go/No-Go and expected previous deployment CAS; use the same candidate, then publish cumulative acceptance receipt only after exact runtime readback.
Read back every component revision and run aggregate health, migration, connectivity and smoke checks; reconcile or roll back ambiguous partial failure.

checks: All deployed components match the aggregate manifest.
Partial deployment and recovery behavior is verified.

phases.name: Root deployment result
phases.description: Publish final aggregate deployment evidence.

instructions.description: Re-read the root Task, all comments and attachments and verify complete runtime state and root smoke evidence against the same aggregate candidate.

Prepare one precise final Business Markdown comment with outcome, aggregate candidate, component readbacks, health, rollback refs and evidence. Submit the final report through project-workflow --json step --task <session> --report <report>; only after its response returns complete=true, post the prepared comment, persist immutable evidence, then call only completeAssignedStage with outcome passed. If incomplete or unhealthy, ask one concrete question or reconcile and do not complete.

checks: Final result covers the whole root release and every blocking child.
Completion is evidence-backed; the model does not invent routing or status.
